value.rationale: A canonical doubly regular tournament yields nontrivial finite-order action on odd torsion that rational homology cannot see. The action splits order-three fixed torsion from order-eleven faithful C5 torsion, precisely addressing a natural source-C3 equivariance setting; neither the 33-torsion order alone nor a textbook deduction determines which order-five character occurs.
